changelog: Added client export, server export, and client event integration directly within the in-game Item Creator.
Added configurable tool durability modes: permanent/infinite tools, durable tools with custom wear rate (%), and standard consumables.
Added support for custom image file names, direct URLs, and drag-and-drop uploads to inventory_images.
Added customizable action duration (usetime), animation, and armed-use toggles for usable items and tools.
